newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 16.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
* U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry said further attacks against Iraqi targets were still possible.
* The presidents of Serbia and Bosnia will meet in Paris in about three weeks.
* The Republican presidential ticket of Bob Dole and Jack Kemp spoke to a rally of Pat Robertson's Christian Coalition Saturday.
* Hospitals in the state of New Jersey are struggling to cope with the burden of "boarder babies" - those who have no place else to go while waiting for foster placement.
* Now a presidential candidate once again, Ross Perot's business and political dealings have been questioned.
